ui_bugs.issue: Wave 14 spec #3 says price/qty/CTAs/delivery-note must be LEFT-aligned, but the right-column wrapper still has className='flex flex-col items-center text-center justify-center' (line 223, comment still reads 'vertically + horizontally centered'). Live computed style on /toner/<id> shows text-align=center on the price element (parent-align=center). Visually all content (brand, model, badges, price block) renders centered. Internal flex rows do use justify-start, but the parent items-center forces horizontal centering on every child block. Buy-now button still uses yellow #F5C400 which is fine, but layout is wrong.

action_items: ProductDetail.jsx line 223: change wrapper from 'flex flex-col items-center text-center justify-center min-h-[460px]' to 'flex flex-col items-start text-left justify-start min-h-[460px]' (or similar) so price, qty, CTAs, delivery-note are LEFT-aligned per Wave 14 spec #3. Also update the inline comment which still reads '55%, vertically + horizontally centered, balanced spacing'.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx line 223 — wrapper still left over from previous wave (items-center text-center). This contradicts the Wave 14 brief that the WHOLE right column should be left-aligned. Internal flex rows already say 'left aligned' in code comments and use justify-start, but they are visually centered because the parent wrapper centers them.
BulkUploadDialog.downloadXLSX uses 'Toners' as sheet name regardless of category — when bulk upload is added for printers/papers in a future wave this will need parametrising (cosmetic).

SupplierAgreementDialog stores localStorage as plain string 'accepted'. Consider storing JSON with timestamp + version so a future v2 of the agreement can supersede it without manual key bumping (current key is .v1 which is fine for now).

rca of the issue: ProductDetail.jsx item #3 regression: when the right column was redesigned for the brand-page look earlier, the wrapper got 'items-center text-center justify-center' so the column would visually center against the image on the left. Wave 14 brief #3 changed the design direction (LEFT-aligned everywhere) and the comments INSIDE the column were updated (lines 273 '/* Price + stock — left aligned */', 294, 304) and inner flex rows do use justify-start, but the parent wrapper className was not flipped. Net effect: justify-start has no visible impact because every child is a full-width or shrink-fit block inside an items-center column. Fix is one-line: line 223 className change to items-start / text-left.
